propositions: A silently-inert primary dedup guard (comment_ids map) survived 6 days of production (2026-08-13 to 2026-08-20) because ACLI's batch mutation envelope carries no top-level id field, never populating the skip condition.
A working secondary dedup fallback (body-equality check) masked the primary skip's failure by absorbing enough traffic that degradation appeared as flakiness rather than total failure.

Test coverage of the dedup path never crosses the seam: apply-side tests seed synthetic id-bearing payloads while differ-side tests stub the binding store, so no test observed that production transport never delivers ids.
Every blocking plan-review criterion (E4, T3) abstains exactly on the external-fact boundary (ACLI response schema) where the defect hid, leaving only advisory criteria to flag it.

No production observability existed for the invariant violation (comment_ids staying empty while bindings and successful posts grew), permitting a committed-state anomaly to go unread for the feature's lifetime.
